name: Darnó (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Darnó (a green and blue shield with yellow trees, a star and a wavy stripe) above a yellow scroll inscribed DARNÓ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
